articles.summary: Dorian LPG Ltd. (NYSE: LPG) (the “Company,” “Dorian LPG,” “we,” “us,” and “our”), a leading owner and operator of modern very large gas carriers (“VLGCs”), today reported its financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Key Recent Developments Declared an irregular cash dividend totaling approximately $53.7 million, or $1.25 per share, to be paid on or about November 24, 2026 to all shareholders of record as of November 9, 2026. Completed the sale of our 2007-built VLGC Captain John NP and received proceeds net of commission of $77.0 million in October 2026. Completed the sale of our 2015-built VLGC Clermont and received proceeds net of commission of $90.4 million in October 2026. Repaid $16.0 million of the 2026 Debt Facility’s revolver in October 2026. Highlights for the Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Revenues of $221.3 million. Time Charter Equivalent (“TCE”) (1) rate per available day for our fleet of $96,990. Net income of $213.9 million, or $4.98 earnings
articles.title: Dorian LPG Ltd. Announces Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
